label: Piper training clips
summary: One line of speech per file, cut with room either side, for fine-tuning a Piper voice.
source: voice-forge TRAINING.md (lead and tail padding) and the English Suno corpus's measured levels

rules.label: Sample peak
rules.note: A clipped clip teaches the model the clip.

rules.label: Noise floor
rules.note: Anything louder between words is a bed under the voice -- the flutes, last time.

rules.label: RMS level
rules.note: The English clips sit at -23.5 dB median, -29 to -21 between the 10th and 90th percentile.

rules.label: Opening silence
rules.note: TRAINING.md: 100-150 ms before the first sound. Zero means a clip that starts mid-sound.

rules.label: Closing silence
rules.note: TRAINING.md: up to 700 ms after the last sound, never trimmed hard.

rules.label: Longest pause inside
rules.note: Joined lines keep about 0.45 s between them; a long gap inside means a cut went wrong.
